_doc: Deterministic agent-dispatch oracle (#1267). Declares the required agent/vertical set for each (tier x track x review_mode x pr_type), INDEPENDENTLY of the selection code, so scripts/check-agent-dispatch.mjs can replay the actual derivation and assert no drift. Stored compressed: a per-tier base + additive track/pr_type modifiers. Resolution is UNION-only (additive; never narrows below the tier floor) — fail-safe toward MORE review. This file is the SSOT for the tier->vertical floor: scripts/route-auditors.mjs reads `tier_verticals` here (replacing its old inlined SIZE_FLOOR_VERTICALS) and src/sizing/sizing.ts::sizeVerticals is asserted equal to it by the gate.
